OSPS-AC-01.01.justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication of every member and allows only secure second factors (TOTP, security keys/passkeys, GitHub Mobile; no SMS), so no account can read or change a repository's sensitive settings without MFA. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/1362#issuecomment-5903994882

OSPS-AC-02.01.justification: The organization's base permission is read, so a new collaborator gets read access until an owner grants more. GOVERNANCE.md's Roles section names who grants it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md

OSPS-AC-03.01.justification: The main-self-merge ruleset requires a pull request for every change to main. Its only bypass actor, the maintainer, holds it in pull_request mode, which excuses the review and never allows a direct push. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets

OSPS-AC-03.02.justification: The main-integrity ruleset has a deletion rule with no bypass actor, and branch protection sets allow_deletions to false, so nobody can delete main. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets

OSPS-AC-04.01.justification: The default GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only at both the organization and the repository, and GitHub Actions cannot approve pull requests; every workflow also declares permissions: contents: read at the top. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#tokens-publishing-scanning

OSPS-AC-04.02.justification: Every workflow sets permissions: contents: read at the top, and a job adds a write scope only where it uses it. zizmor's excessive-permissions audit runs in the required lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#what-every-workflow-does

OSPS-BR-01.01.justification: No workflow uses pull_request_target or workflow_run. Untrusted event fields and dispatch inputs reach run: steps only through env:, and zizmor's template-injection audit in the required lint check refuses the unsafe form. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

OSPS-BR-01.03.justification: Pull-request runs use the pull_request and pull_request_review_comment triggers, which give a fork no secrets and a read-only token. The review job, which holds a secret, runs only when the head repository is this one. On issue_comment, the mention job, which holds a secret on any pull request, checks out the default branch. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-claude-review.yml

OSPS-BR-01.04.justification: The only workflow_dispatch input is mutation.yml's profile, a choice from a fixed list. A release tag's name is checked against the package version before anything is built. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/mutation.yml

OSPS-BR-02.01.justification: Each release has a unique calendar version, YYYY.M.D, set by a signed v* tag. release.yml's version-check job refuses a tag that differs from the package version or is not on main, and PyPI never accepts a version twice. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/releases

OSPS-BR-02.02.justification: Every release asset carries the version in its file name, and the attestation binds each asset to its digest. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/releases/latest

OSPS-BR-03.01.justification: Every official channel the project lists is served over HTTPS only: the GitHub repository, its issue tracker and advisories, and the documentation at https://btclib-wallet.readthedocs.io/.

OSPS-BR-03.02.justification: Releases are distributed through PyPI and GitHub Releases, both HTTPS-only; PyPI files carry PEP 740 attestations and the GitHub release a Sigstore bundle, so a tampered download fails verification. https://pypi.org/project/btclib-wallet/

OSPS-BR-04.01.justification: Every release carries CHANGELOG.md's entry (every change) and RELEASE_NOTES.md's (what a user must act on, breaking and security changes included); the GitHub release body is the release notes. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

OSPS-BR-05.01.justification: Python dependencies come from PyPI, and the required test check runs the suite with uv from the committed uv.lock with --locked. pre-commit installs its hooks at the revisions .pre-commit-config.yaml names. Third-party actions are pinned by commit SHA. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#uvlock

OSPS-BR-06.01.justification: Every PyPI file carries a PEP 740 attestation, and each GitHub release a Sigstore bundle. The tag is signed. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/releases/latest

OSPS-BR-07.01.justification: Secret scanning and push protection are on, so a push with a recognised credential is refused. The detect-private-key and detect-secrets hooks run against .secrets.baseline in the required lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.secrets.baseline

OSPS-BR-07.02.justification: A secret is an environment secret only the owners reach, and any other store's entry is recorded in the spending repository's REPOSITORY.md. A secret is rotated when an owner changes or an exposure is suspected, and the list is reviewed yearly. btclib-org/.github's tests/secrets_test.py refuses an unrecorded entry. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L2913-L2940

OSPS-DO-01.01.justification: README.md's Installing and An address from a mnemonic sections give the first use. The API reference is at https://btclib-wallet.readthedocs.io/. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/README.md

OSPS-DO-02.01.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md's *The issue tracker* says where a defect is filed, and the bug-report issue form (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml) asks for what a report needs; SECURITY.md routes a vulnerability away from the public tracker. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml

OSPS-DO-03.01.justification: SECURITY.md gives the gh attestation verify command for the release files. RELEASING.md adds the offline --bundle form and a rebuild from the tag that passes only if its digests match the attested ones. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-03.02.justification: SECURITY.md gives the gh attestation verify command, with --repo and --signer-workflow naming the organization's reusable-build.yml and --source-ref the release tag. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-04.01.justification: SECURITY.md's *Supported versions*: only the latest release is supported, a fix ships as a new release, and nothing is backported. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-05.01.justification: SECURITY.md's *Supported versions* states that a release stops receiving security updates as soon as the next one is published, since only the latest is supported and nothing is backported. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-06.01.justification: pyproject.toml says beside each runtime dependency why it is one, and ARCHITECTURE.md's *The dependencies* says why each sibling package is one. Dependencies come from PyPI through uv, are pinned in uv.lock, and Dependabot updates them weekly with a seven-day cooldown. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

OSPS-DO-07.01.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md's *The environment and the gates* gives the build: uv sync creates the environment from uv.lock, and uv build produces the sdist and wheel. uv is the only prerequisite, except a Rust toolchain on Python 3.15. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-01.01.justification: GOVERNANCE.md names who holds access to sensitive resources: the maintainer, the only bypass actor, and the three owners, each an administrator of every repository and a reviewer of the publishing environments. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

OSPS-GV-01.02.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's *Roles* describes the maintainer, owners, repository collaborators, contributors, reviewers, the review bot, Dependabot and pre-commit.ci, and what each owes. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

OSPS-GV-02.01.justification: Proposed changes and usage obstacles are discussed publicly in the repository's GitHub issues (with a question form) and pull requests; cross-repository questions go to btclib-org/.github's tracker. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/issues

OSPS-GV-03.01.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process: an issue first, one subject per pull request, the local gates, the review and the landing. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-03.02.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states what an acceptable contribution meets: an issue behind it, one subject, the lint gate (ruff select ALL, strict mypy), line and branch coverage at 100%, a signed commit, and a review against REVIEWING.md. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-04.01.justification: A grant of write or admin, to any repository of the organization, is an issue in btclib-org/.github that states the reason, and an owner other than the one asking approves it there. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/GOVERNANCE.md#L44-L46

OSPS-LE-01.01.justification: main requires the lint / Sign-off check, which refuses a commit that lacks its author's Signed-off-by: trailer, Dependabot's and pre-commit.ci's aside. Web commits are signed off automatically. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/scripts/check_sign_off.py

OSPS-LE-02.01.justification: The source code is under the MIT license, which the OSI approves. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-LE-02.02.justification: The released wheels and sdist declare License-Expression: MIT, the same OSI-approved license as the source. https://pypi.org/project/btclib-wallet/

OSPS-LE-03.01.justification: The license text is the repository's root LICENSE file. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-LE-03.02.justification: The LICENSE file ships inside every release asset: the sdist root and the wheel's .dist-info/licenses/. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-QA-01.01.justification: The repository is public on GitHub at a static URL. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet

OSPS-QA-01.02.justification: Git history on GitHub records every change with its author, committer, date and signature; linear history and no force-pushes on main keep that record from being rewritten. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/commits/main

OSPS-QA-02.01.justification: pyproject.toml declares the direct dependencies ([project] dependencies, optional extras and dependency groups), and the committed uv.lock resolves and pins them. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

OSPS-QA-02.02.justification: Every release attaches a CycloneDX 1.6 SBOM, <name>-<version>.cdx.json, built from the wheel and covered by the release attestation. It lists both files' SHA-256, the license and the declared dependencies. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/releases/latest

OSPS-QA-03.01.justification: main requires the CI status checks, up to date with main (strict). enforce_admins is off, so an admin merge without them is a manual bypass, which the control allows. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets

OSPS-QA-04.01.justification: The organization standard's section 2 (*Which repositories, and how far*) lists every repository of btclib-org and its tier, and the organization profile lists the published packages. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#which-repositories-and-how-far

OSPS-QA-04.02.justification: Each release is built from this single repository; the sibling packages it depends on are released separately from their own repositories, which are held to the same standard. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet

OSPS-QA-05.01.justification: No executable is committed. The binary files are test vectors and fuzz seeds in Bitcoin's own serialization, and the docs' copy of Python's Sphinx inventory; check-added-large-files runs in the lint gate. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet

OSPS-QA-05.02.justification: The binary files are test vectors and fuzz seeds in Bitcoin's own serialization, and docs/source/_inventories/python.inv, Python's Sphinx inventory. tests/_data/README.md pins the blocks to their source, and docs/source/conf.py gives the command that fetches the inventory. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/tests/_data/README.md

OSPS-QA-06.01.justification: test.yml's aggregate check ('test: every job passed') runs the test suite on every pull request and is a required status check on main. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml

OSPS-QA-06.02.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md's *The environment and the gates* gives the command that runs the suite and which workflows run it on every pull request, on main and on a schedule, and which of them gate a merge. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-QA-06.03.justification: The policy is 100% line and branch coverage, stated in CONTRIBUTING.md, and pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100, so untested new code fails the required test check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

OSPS-QA-07.01.justification: main requires one non-author approval, but the maintainer's bypass, meant for emergencies only, is used routinely: 38 of the last 40 merged pull requests have no non-author approval. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md

OSPS-SA-01.01.justification: ARCHITECTURE.md documents the components, their layering and every place the software reaches outside the process, and ASSURANCE_CASE.md's *Trust boundaries* and *Threat model* name the actors and what each can do. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md

OSPS-SA-02.01.justification: The API reference at https://btclib-wallet.readthedocs.io/ is generated from the docstrings of every public module (ruff's D rules require them, and a docs test fails when a shipped module is missing from the reference); CONTRIBUTING.md's *The public surface* states what is public.

OSPS-SA-03.01.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md is the security assessment: what is claimed, the threat model, the trust boundaries and how each common implementation weakness is countered; SECURITY.md's limitations section records the known residual risks. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

OSPS-SA-03.02.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md's *Threat model* names the assets, adversaries and what is not defended, and *Trust boundaries* maps the attack surface where untrusted input enters, each argument naming the file, test or workflow behind it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

OSPS-VM-01.01.justification: SECURITY.md gives the private reporting channels and states the timeframes: a report is acknowledged within 7 days, and a fix or a published advisory follows within 90 days. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L19

OSPS-VM-02.01.justification: SECURITY.md names the security contacts: a private GitHub security advisory, or email to security at btclib dot org, which reaches the three organization owners. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-VM-03.01.justification: Private vulnerability reporting is enabled, and SECURITY.md points to it (the Security tab's 'Report a vulnerability') and gives an email address as the alternative. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/security/advisories/new

OSPS-VM-04.01.justification: Vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories on this repository, each naming the release that fixes it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/security/advisories

OSPS-VM-04.02.justification: Each release's CycloneDX SBOM lists in its vulnerabilities array every vulnerability judged not to affect it, with the reason, from the tree's .github/vex.toml. None is judged so today, so the tree has no such file. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L3120-L3135

OSPS-VM-05.01.justification: Every pull request runs actions/dependency-review-action, which fails on an added or changed dependency with an advisory of moderate severity or above, or with a licence outside the allow-list. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L2892-L2909

OSPS-VM-05.02.justification: release.yml runs uv audit over every dependency the wheel declares before any publish job. An advisory, or a service it cannot reach, stops the release. The only exemption is an id the release's own signed VEX states as not affecting it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L3149-L3160

OSPS-VM-05.03.justification: The Dependency review job runs on every pull request and is a required check on main (lint / Dependency review), so a pull request that violates the policy cannot merge without an admin bypass. Policy: https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L2892-L2909

OSPS-VM-06.01.justification: The standard's section 5 sets the threshold at zero: ruff runs select = ALL, bandit's S rules included, and every finding is fixed or suppressed at its site with a reason; zizmor does the same for workflows. CodeQL alerts have no stated threshold. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#5-ruff

OSPS-VM-06.02.justification: The required lint check runs .pre-commit-config.yaml on every pull request: ruff with the bandit S rules, strict mypy, zizmor and detect-secrets. Any finding blocks the merge unless suppressed at its site with a reason. CodeQL also runs on every pull request, but is not a required check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/lint.yml

access_continuity.justification: The organization has three owners, fametrano, giacomocaironi and pmazzocchi, each an administrator of this repository and a reviewer of its publishing environments. If one becomes unavailable, the other two can still close issues, merge changes and release. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity

accessibility_best_practices.justification: btclib-wallet is a library with no user interface. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/README.md

assurance_case.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md states the threat model, the trust boundaries, the secure-design argument and the argument against common implementation weaknesses, citing the file, test or workflow behind each claim. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

automated_integration_testing.justification: test.yml runs the suite, and integration-bitcoind.yml the regtest tests against Bitcoin Core, on every pull request and on pushes to main; both are required checks on main. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml

build_non_recursive.justification: This tree builds no native binaries, so there is no recursive-build question to answer. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

build_preserve_debug.justification: No native build or installation step exists to strip or preserve debugging information. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

build_repeatable.justification: Every week sdist-rebuild.yml rebuilds the latest release's sdist from its tag. It passes only if the rebuilt file matches the release's attested digest byte for byte. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/sdist-rebuild.yml

build_reproducible.justification: The sdist is built with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH from the commit. Every week sdist-rebuild.yml rebuilds the latest release's sdist from its signed tag and verifies it against the release's build attestation, and RELEASING.md gives the same check to anyone. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/sdist-rebuild.yml

build_standard_variables.justification: This tree is pure Python on the uv_build backend and builds no native binary, so no compiler or linker runs. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

bus_factor.justification: One maintainer wrote 171 of the 190 commits on main, and a second owner wrote 11. Continuity rests on the three organization owners named in GOVERNANCE.md. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md

code_of_conduct.justification: The organization's CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md applies here, and GitHub's community profile of this repository shows it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md

code_review_standards.justification: REVIEWING.md states what a review checks, how a finding is written and what clears a pull request; the part shared by every repository is followed by what this tree checks in particular. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/REVIEWING.md

coding_standards.justification: pyproject.toml's [tool.ruff] selects every rule (select = ["ALL"]) with a documented ignore list, and [tool.mypy] is strict. CONTRIBUTING.md names both and the commands that enforce them. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

coding_standards_enforced.justification: ruff-check, ruff-format and mypy are pre-commit hooks, and lint.yml runs .pre-commit-config.yaml as a required check on every pull request. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

contribution_requirements.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states the coding-standard, lint-gate and 100%-coverage requirements a contribution must meet before it can land. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

contributors_unassociated.justification: The project has one significant contributor, so it does not have two unassociated ones.

copyright_per_file.justification: Every .py file opens with "Copyright (c) The btclib developers", e.g. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/src/btclib_wallet/__init__.py

crypto_algorithm_agility.justification: A wallet signs what the consensus rules define, and Bitcoin's consensus rules fix secp256k1, SHA-256 and the signature schemes. Another algorithm needs a soft fork first, and the project follows one when it activates. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/README.md

crypto_call.justification: Cryptography is delegated to btclib-ecc and btclib, not reimplemented.

crypto_certificate_verification.justification: TlsLineTransport uses ssl.create_default_context(), which verifies the certificate chain and host name. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/src/btclib_wallet/fetch/transport.py

crypto_credential_agility.justification: btclib_wallet.fetch.bitcoin_core re-exports bitcoin-core-rpc's cookie_auth, COOKIE_USER and DEFAULT_DATADIR, so a BitcoinCoreFetcher can authenticate with Bitcoin Core's cookie file, read at each call, and the credential changes without a code change. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/src/btclib_wallet/fetch/bitcoin_core.py

crypto_keylength.justification: Keys are secp256k1 keys, about 128 bits of security, and BIP39 entropy is at least 128 bits, above NIST's 112-bit floor for 2030. TLS uses Python's default context, whose security level 2 refuses keys under 112 bits. https://docs.python.org/3/whatsnew/3.10.html#ssl

crypto_pfs.justification: TLS uses Python's default context, which since Python 3.10 disables cipher suites without forward secrecy; the floor here is 3.11. https://docs.python.org/3/whatsnew/3.10.html#ssl

crypto_published.justification: Cryptography is delegated to btclib-ecc and btclib, which implement published algorithms. btclib-ecc calls Bitcoin Core's libsecp256k1 through btclib-secp256k1 when installed.

crypto_random.justification: BIP38 salts and seeds come from Python's secrets module, and mnemonic entropy from btclib-mnemonics, which uses secrets or os.urandom. Signing is btclib-ecc's: RFC 6979 nonces, and BIP340 auxiliary randomness from secrets. The only random.Random is coin selection's UTXO shuffle, which makes no key or nonce. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/tree/main/src/btclib_wallet

crypto_tls12.justification: TlsLineTransport sets minimum_version to TLS 1.2 itself. The other backends use bitcoin-core-rpc's HTTPS. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/src/btclib_wallet/fetch/transport.py

crypto_used_network.justification: TlsLineTransport verifies the server certificate and host name by default. The Esplora and Core backends use bitcoin-core-rpc's verifying HTTPS. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/src/btclib_wallet/fetch/transport.py

crypto_verification_private.justification: TlsLineTransport completes the TLS handshake before it writes the request line. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/src/btclib_wallet/fetch/transport.py

crypto_weaknesses.justification: Signing runs through btclib-ecc, on SHA-256 (RFC 6979, BIP340). BIP38's AES-256 is supplied by the caller, and SECURITY.md says that BIP38 has no MAC by its own specification. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md

dco.justification: main requires the lint / Sign-off check, which refuses a pull request with a commit that lacks its author's Signed-off-by: trailer. Dependabot's and pre-commit.ci's commits are exempt. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/scripts/check_sign_off.py

delivery_mitm.justification: Distribution channels (GitHub, PyPI) use HTTPS exclusively.

delivery_unsigned.justification: Releases and their hashes are served over HTTPS only, from PyPI and GitHub.

dependency_monitoring.justification: Dependabot's version updates are configured in .github/dependabot.yml, and its security updates are on. CodeQL and OpenSSF Scorecard also run on a schedule. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml

discussion.justification: GitHub supports discussions on issues and pull requests.

documentation_achievements.justification: README.md shows and links the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, beside the Scorecard badge. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/README.md

documentation_architecture.justification: ARCHITECTURE.md documents which module holds what, the dependencies (btclib, btclib-ecc, btclib-mnemonics, bitcoin-core-rpc) and why each, and every place a module reaches outside the process: HWI's subprocess and the fetch backends' sockets. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md

documentation_current.justification: The API reference is generated from the docstrings, and docs.yml builds it with -W -n as a required check on every pull request. tests/docs_test.py fails when a shipped module is missing from it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/docs.yml

documentation_quick_start.justification: README.md's *Installing* and *An address from a mnemonic* sections walk a new user through a first use. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/README.md

documentation_roadmap.justification: ROADMAP.md, in btclib-org/.github, covers the period until 2027-09-30, is reviewed every September, and says what is intended and what is not. README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md link it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/ROADMAP.md

documentation_security.justification: SECURITY.md's *Where constant time ends* says which operations reach libsecp256k1, that secrets are not zeroized, that BIP38 has no MAC and where randomness comes from. *A backend is trusted, and not every backend alike* says how far each fetch backend's answers are checked. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md

dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions.justification: The tests, mutation runs and fuzz targets run Python without -O, so assertions are enabled.

dynamic_analysis_fixed.justification: No fuzzing or mutation-testing finding is open. The latest fuzz run on main, 2026-10-07, and the latest mutation run, 2026-10-05, passed. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/actions/workflows/fuzz.yml

dynamic_analysis_unsafe.justification: This tree is pure Python, a memory-safe language. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

external_dependencies.justification: Every dependency is declared in machine-readable form in pyproject.toml's [project.dependencies] and dependency-groups, resolved and pinned in the committed uv.lock. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

floss_license.justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).

floss_license_osi.justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).

governance.justification: GOVERNANCE.md, in btclib-org/.github, documents how decisions are made, the maintainer's bypass and every role; README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md link it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md

hardened_site.justification: The project site is served over HTTPS and answers Content-Security-Policy with frame-ancestors 'none', X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Strict-Transport-Security. Check with curl -sI https://btclib.org/btclib-wallet/

hardening.justification: ruff's select = ["ALL"] includes the bandit S rules, so unsafe deserialization, weak temporary files and shell injection fail the lint gate. CodeQL also runs on every pull request. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml

implement_secure_design.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md argues each secure-design principle against this tree, and ARCHITECTURE.md lays out the signing boundary and the backends a wallet trusts; SECURITY.md applies it where constant time ends and to what a backend is trusted with. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

input_validation.justification: Every public function validates its inputs and refuses what is invalid; the unchecked work lives in a private twin the public function calls once it has validated, as CONTRIBUTING.md requires. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

installation_common.justification: pip install btclib-wallet installs it from PyPI, and pip uninstall removes it; README.md gives the command. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/README.md

installation_development_quick.justification: uv sync installs the development environment in one command; CONTRIBUTING.md's *The environment and the gates* gives it beside the gates. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

installation_standard_variables.justification: Installation is pip install, which follows pip's own conventions for where files go; the project has no installer of its own. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

interfaces_current.justification: ruff's UP and FA rules flag deprecated constructs, and pytest turns every warning into an error. deps-latest and deps-oldest run the suite weekly at the newest and the floor versions. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

internationalization.justification: Output is technical data (hex, addresses, PSBTs), and the package has no interactive prompt or user interface meant for localization. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/README.md

license_per_file.justification: Every .py file states "Distributed under the MIT software license, see the accompanying LICENSE file or https://opensource.org/license/mit", e.g. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/src/btclib_wallet/__init__.py

maintenance_or_update.justification: Only the latest release is supported, and nothing is backported, as SECURITY.md's *Supported versions* says. RELEASE_NOTES.md says, for each breaking change, what a user has to change. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

regression_tests_added50.justification: Every merged pull request that changes src/ also changes tests/, bar one that only edits a docstring (#297). The 100% line and branch coverage gate also fails a fix whose new code no test runs. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged

release_notes_vulns.justification: The release notes name the GHSA id of each advisory published by the time of the release: v2026.10.4 names GHSA-qq38-77mp-j6wr and GHSA-v4gq-j2v2-c4jp, and v2026.10.9 names GHSA-8qrf-j8jh-cx23. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

repo_distributed.justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.

repo_interim.justification: development is on the main branch of https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet

repo_public.justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.

repo_track.justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git can track the changes, who made them, and when they were made.

report_tracker.justification: Each repository uses its own GitHub Issues tracker for individual issues, with issue forms under .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, and an organization-wide tracker in btclib-org/.github for cross-repository findings. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/issues

require_2FA.justification: The btclib-org GitHub organization requires two-factor authentication of every member (organization setting two_factor_requirement_enabled = true), so nobody without 2FA can change a repository. https://github.com/btclib-org

roles_responsibilities.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's *Roles* names the maintainer, the owners, repository administrators and collaborators, contributors, reviewers, the review bot, Dependabot and pre-commit.ci, and what each owes. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

secure_2FA.justification: The btclib-org GitHub organization requires two-factor authentication of every member and has 'Only allow secure two-factor methods' selected, which refuses SMS as a second factor: only TOTP apps, security keys/passkeys and GitHub Mobile are accepted. Read from the organization's security settings on 2026-09-30 and recorded at https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/1362#issuecomment-5903994882

security_review.justification: pmazzocchi, an owner other than the maintainer, reviewed the tree on 2026-09-30 against ASSURANCE_CASE.md, claim by claim. Issue 169 records the scope, the method, what was not covered and the findings, each filed as an issue. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/issues/169

signed_releases.justification: Every PyPI file carries a PEP 740 attestation, and each GitHub release a Sigstore provenance bundle. Every release tag is signed. SECURITY.md gives the gh attestation verify command. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/releases/latest

sites_password_security.justification: Project sites are GitHub, PyPI and Read the Docs; none of these repositories runs a site of its own that stores user passwords -- authentication is GitHub's and PyPI's, not this project's. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md

small_tasks.justification: Small tasks for newcomers carry the label "good first issue", which CONTRIBUTING.md sets aside for a first contribution. 15 issues have carried it in the last 12 months. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/issues?q=label%3A%22good+first+issue%22

static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities.justification: ruff, a FLOSS tool, runs select = ["ALL"], bandit's S rules included, in the required lint check. CodeQL also runs on every pull request, every push to main and weekly. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml

static_analysis_fixed.justification: CodeQL has no open alert, and ruff and mypy findings block the merge. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml

static_analysis_often.justification: lint.yml (ruff, mypy) and codeql.yml run on every pull request and every push to main. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/actions/workflows/lint.yml

test.justification: 100% coverage floor, enforced locally and in CI: https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/actions/workflows/test.yml

test_branch_coverage80.justification: pyproject.toml sets branch = true in [tool.coverage.run], and the 100% gate includes branch coverage. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

test_continuous_integration.justification: test.yml runs the suite on every pull request and on every push to main that changes more than markdown files, and its aggregate check is required on main. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml

test_policy_mandated.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires 100% coverage, and pyproject.toml's fail_under = 100.0 fails the required test check when new code has no test. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

test_statement_coverage80.justification: pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100.0 in [tool.coverage.report], and the required test check enforces it on every pull request. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

test_statement_coverage90.justification: pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100.0 in [tool.coverage.report], and the coverage job gates every pull request. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

tests_documented_added.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires 100% coverage of every change, so new functionality is not accepted without a test. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

two_person_review.justification: main requires one non-author approval, but the maintainer's bypass, meant for emergencies only, is used routinely: 38 of the last 40 merged pull requests have no non-author approval. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md

updateable_reused_components.justification: Reused components are standard-library modules or PyPI packages pinned in uv.lock. Dependabot updates them weekly, and deps-latest runs the suite weekly against their latest releases. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/.github/workflows/deps-latest.yml

version_semver.justification: Calendar versioning, YYYY.M.D, with the day as the micro level; each release is tagged v<version>. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github#12-releasing

version_tags_signed.justification: Every release tag is signed, and RELEASING.md reads each signature back. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/tags

vulnerabilities_critical_fixed.justification: No publicly known vulnerability is left unfixed: each published advisory names the release that fixes it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/security/advisories

vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days.justification: No publicly known vulnerability is left unpatched. Each was fixed in a release within four days of being reported. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/security/advisories

vulnerability_report_credit.justification: pmazzocchi, who reported GHSA-qq38-77mp-j6wr and GHSA-v4gq-j2v2-c4jp, is credited as finder on both. The maintainer filed GHSA-62jf-v327-86h5 and GHSA-8qrf-j8jh-cx23; pmazzocchi is credited on the first as remediation developer, pending his acceptance. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/security/advisories

vulnerability_report_response.justification: The two vulnerabilities reported by someone other than the maintainer, GHSA-qq38-77mp-j6wr and GHSA-v4gq-j2v2-c4jp, were opened on 2026-09-30 and fixed and published on 2026-10-04 with v2026.10.4. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/security/advisories

vulnerability_response_process.justification: SECURITY.md's *Reporting a vulnerability* gives the private channels, a GitHub security advisory or security at btclib dot org, says who can see a report and how a CVE is requested. Private vulnerability reporting is enabled. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md

warnings.justification: mypy strict with all relevant extra checks activated, see https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

warnings_fixed.justification: warnings are not tolerated: mypy strict with all relevant extra checks activated, see https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml

warnings_strict.justification: ruff runs with `select = ["ALL"]` (every rule family) and mypy runs with `strict = true`; both are required, zero-finding pre-commit hooks enforced again in the lint workflow. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-wallet/blob/main/pyproject.toml
